sandbachFocus: Sandbach United host Eccleshall at home on Saturday in a third-versus-fourth clash. The Ramblers are looking to capitalize on their strong home form and extend their impressive five-game unbeaten run, which includes a recent draw. Eccleshall arrive as dangerous visitors, currently fourth in the table and on a four-game winning streak of their own, so this should be a competitive encounter.
divisionWide: The title race remains tight at the top, with AFC Bridgnorth (first, 19 points) hosting Brereton Social and Stafford Town (second, 19 points) away at Cheadle Heath Nomads—both teams level on points and needing wins to pull clear. Crewe welcome struggling Wednesfield Community in a match between two sides in poor form, while Wolverhampton Casuals travel to Shawbury United in a mid-table encounter. Foley Meir host bottom-placed Widnes Town in what should be a more straightforward fixture for the hosts. Market Drayton Town visit Bilston Town in a clash between mid-table sides, New Mills host Dawley Town in a battle of sides seeking consistency, and Telford Town face Barnton. Allscott Heath welcome struggling Alsager Town, with the visitors traveling in search of their first points for some time.
